traditions.LXX: Τάδε λέγει Κύριος
traditions.KJV: Thus saith the LORD ;

1.english_reference: Behold , I will raise up against Babylon ,

traditions.LXX: Ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐξεγείρω ἐπὶ Βαβυλῶνα
traditions.KJV: Behold , I will raise up against Babylon ,

1.english_reference: and against them that dwell in the midst of them that rise up against me ,

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Χαλδαίους
traditions.VUL: et super habitatóres eius , qui cor suum levavérunt contra me ,
traditions.KJV: and against them that dwell in the midst of them that rise up against me ,

traditions.LXX: ἄνεμον καύσωνα διαφθείροντα .
traditions.KJV: a destroying wind ;

2.english_reference: And will send unto Babylon fanners, that shall fan her, and shall empty her land

traditions.WLC: וְ שִׁלַּחְתִּ֨י לְ בָבֶ֤ל זָרִים֙ וְ זֵר֔וּ הָ וִ יבֹקְק֖וּ אֶת אַרְצָ֑ הּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξαποστελῶ εἰς Βαβυλῶνα ὑβριστάς , καὶ καθυβρίσουσιν αὐτὴν καὶ λυμανοῦνται τὴν γῆν αὐτῆς ·
traditions.VUL: Et mittam in Babylónem ventilatóres , et ventilábunt eam , et demoliéntur terram eius :
traditions.KJV: And will send unto Babylon fanners , that shall fan her , and shall empty her land :

2.english_reference: for in the day of trouble they shall be against her round about

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי הָי֥וּ עָלֶ֛י הָ מִ סָּבִ֖יב בְּ י֥וֹם רָעָֽה
traditions.LXX: οὐαὶ ἐπὶ Βαβυλῶνα κυκλόθεν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ κακώσεως αὐτῆς .
traditions.VUL: quóniam venérunt super eam úndique in die afflictiónis eius .
traditions.KJV: for in the day of trouble they shall be against her round about .

3.english_reference: Against bendeth let the archer bend his bow, and against lifteth himself up in his brigandine

traditions.WLC: אֶֽל יִדְרֹ֤ךְ ידרך הַ דֹּרֵךְ֙ קַשְׁתּ֔ וֹ וְ אֶל יִתְעַ֖ל בְּ סִרְיֹנ֑ וֹ
traditions.LXX: τεινέτω ὁ τείνων τὸ τόξον αὐτοῦ , καὶ περιθέσθω ᾧ ἐστὶν ὅπλα αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: Non tendat qui tendit arcum suum , et non ascéndat loricátus ,
traditions.KJV: Against [ him that ] bendeth let the archer bend his bow , and against [ him that ] lifteth himself up in his brigandine :

3.english_reference: and spare ye not her young men

traditions.WLC: וְ אַֽל תַּחְמְלוּ֙ אֶל בַּ֣חֻרֶ֔י הָ
traditions.LXX: καὶ μὴ φείσησθε ἐπὶ νεανίσκους αὐτῆς
traditions.KJV: and spare ye not her young men ;

3.english_reference: destroy ye utterly all her host

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀφανίσατε πᾶσαν τὴν δύναμιν αὐτῆς .
traditions.KJV: destroy ye utterly all her host .

4.english_reference: Thus the slain shall fall in the land of the Chaldeans

traditions.WLC: וְ נָפְל֥וּ חֲלָלִ֖ים בְּ אֶ֣רֶץ כַּשְׂדִּ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ πεσοῦνται τραυματίαι ἐν γῇ Χαλδαίων
traditions.VUL: Et cadent interfécti in terra Chaldæórum ,
traditions.KJV: Thus the slain shall fall in the land of the Chaldeans ,

4.english_reference: and thrust through in her streets

traditions.LXX: καὶ κατακεκεντημένοι ἔξωθεν αὐτῆς .
traditions.KJV: and [ they that are ] thrust through in her streets .

5.english_reference: For Israel hath not been forsaken, nor Judah of his God, of the LORD of hosts

traditions.WLC: כִּ֠י לֹֽא אַלְמָ֨ן יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל וִֽ יהוּדָה֙ מֵֽ אֱלֹהָ֔י ו מֵֽ יְהוָ֖ה צְבָא֑וֹת
traditions.LXX: διότι οὐκ ἐχήρευσεν Ἰσραὴλ καὶ Ἰούδας ἀπὸ θεοῦ αὐτῶν , ἀπὸ Κυρίου Παντοκράτορος ·
traditions.VUL: Quóniam non fuit viduátus Israel et Iuda a Deo suo Dómino exercítuum :
traditions.KJV: For Israel [ hath ] not [ been ] forsaken , nor Judah of his God , of the LORD of hosts ;

5.english_reference: though their land was filled with sin against the Holy One of Israel

traditions.WLC: כִּ֤י אַרְצָ ם֙ מָלְאָ֣ה אָשָׁ֔ם מִ קְּד֖וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἡ γῆ αὐτῶν ἐπλήσθη ἀδικίας ἀπὸ τῶν ἁγίων Ἰσραήλ .
traditions.VUL: terra autem eórum repléta est delícto a sancto Israel .
traditions.KJV: though their land was filled with sin against the Holy One of Israel .

6.english_reference: Flee out of the midst of Babylon, and deliver every man his soul

traditions.WLC: נֻ֣סוּ מִ תּ֣וֹךְ בָּבֶ֗ל וּ מַלְּטוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ נַפְשׁ֔ וֹ
traditions.LXX: φεύγετε ἐκ μέσου Βαβυλῶνος καὶ ἀνασώζετε ἕκαστος τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: Fúgite de médio Babylónis , et salvet unusquísque ánimam suam :
traditions.KJV: Flee out of the midst of Babylon , and deliver every man his soul :

6.english_reference: be not cut off in her iniquity

traditions.LXX: καὶ μὴ ἀποριφῆτε ἐν τῇ ἀδικίᾳ αὐτῆς ,
traditions.KJV: be not cut off in her iniquity ;

6.english_reference: for this is the time of the LORD'S vengeance

traditions.WLC: כִּי֩ עֵ֨ת נְקָמָ֥ה הִיא֙ לַֽ יהוָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: ὅτι καιρὸς ἐκδικήσεως αὐτῆς ἐστιν παρὰ Κυρίου ,
traditions.VUL: quóniam tempus ultiónis est a Dómino ,
traditions.KJV: for this [ is ] the time of the LORD ’S vengeance ;

6.english_reference: he will render unto her a recompence

traditions.LXX: ἀνταπόδομα αὐτὸς ἀνταποδίδωσιν αὐτῇ .
traditions.KJV: he will render unto her a recompence .

7.english_reference: Babylon hath been a golden cup in the LORD'S hand, that made all the earth drunken

traditions.WLC: כּוֹס זָהָ֤ב בָּבֶל֙ בְּ יַד יְהוָ֔ה מְשַׁכֶּ֖רֶת כָּל הָ אָ֑רֶץ
traditions.LXX: ποτήριον χρυσοῦν Βαβυλὼν ἐν χειρὶ Κυρίου , μεθύσκον πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν ·
traditions.VUL: Calix áureus Bábylon in manu Dómini , inébrians omnem terram :
traditions.KJV: Babylon [ hath been ] a golden cup in the LORD ’S hand , that made all the earth drunken :

7.english_reference: the nations have drunken of her wine

traditions.LXX: ἀπὸ τοῦ οἴνου αὐτῆς ἐπίοσαν ἔθνη ,
traditions.KJV: the nations have drunken of her wine ;

traditions.LXX: διὰ τοῦτο ἐσαλεύθησαν ·
traditions.KJV: therefore the nations are mad .

8.english_reference: Babylon is suddenly fallen and destroyed

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἄφνω ἔπεσεν Βαβυλὼν καὶ συνετρίβη .
traditions.VUL: Súbito cécidit Bábylon , et contríta est .
traditions.KJV: Babylon is suddenly fallen and destroyed :

traditions.LXX: θρηνεῖτε αὐτήν ,
traditions.KJV: howl for her ;

8.english_reference: take balm for her pain, if so be she may be healed

traditions.WLC: קְח֤וּ צֳרִי֙ לְ מַכְאוֹבָ֔ הּ אוּלַ֖י תֵּרָפֵֽא
traditions.LXX: λάβετε ῥητίνην τῇ διαφθορᾷ αὐτῆς , εἴ πως ἰαθήσεται .
traditions.VUL: tóllite resínam ad dolórem eius , si forte sanétur .
traditions.KJV: take balm for her pain , if so be she may be healed .

9.english_reference: We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed

traditions.WLC: רפאנו אֶת בָּבֶל֙ וְ לֹ֣א נִרְפָּ֔תָה
traditions.LXX: ἰατρεύσαμεν τὴν Βαβυλῶνα , καὶ οὐκ ἰάθη ·
traditions.VUL: Curávimus Babylónem , et non est sanáta :
traditions.KJV: We would have healed Babylon , but she is not healed :

9.english_reference: forsake her, and let us go every one into his own country

traditions.WLC: עִזְב֕וּ הָ וְ נֵלֵ֖ךְ אִ֣ישׁ לְ אַרְצ֑ וֹ
traditions.LXX: ἐνκαταλίπωμεν αὐτὴν καὶ ἀπέλθωμεν ἕκαστος εἰς τὴν γῆν αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: derelinquámus eam , et eámus unusquísque in terram suam :
traditions.KJV: forsake her , and let us go every one into his own country :

9.english_reference: for her judgment reacheth unto heaven, and is lifted up even to the skies

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי נָגַ֤ע אֶל הַ שָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ מִשְׁפָּטָ֔ הּ וְ נִשָּׂ֖א עַד שְׁחָקִֽים
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἤγγικεν εἰς οὐρανὸν τὸ κρίμα αὐτῆς , ἐξῆρεν ἕως τῶν ἄστρων .
traditions.VUL: quóniam pervénit usque ad cælos iudícium eius , et elevátum est usque ad nubes .
traditions.KJV: for her judgment reacheth unto heaven , and is lifted up [ even ] to the skies .

10.english_reference: The LORD hath brought forth our righteousness

traditions.LXX: ἐξήνεγκεν Κύριος τὸ κρίμα αὐτοῦ ·
traditions.KJV: The LORD hath brought forth our righteousness :

10.english_reference: come, and let us declare in Zion the work of the LORD our God

traditions.WLC: בֹּ֚אוּ וּ נְסַפְּרָ֣ה בְ צִיּ֔וֹן אֶֽת מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי נוּ
traditions.LXX: δεῦτε καὶ ἀναγγείλωμεν ἐν Σειὼν τὰ ἔργα Κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν .
traditions.VUL: veníte , et narrémus in Sion opus Dómini Dei nostri .
traditions.KJV: come , and let us declare in Zion the work of the LORD our God .

traditions.LXX: παρασκευάζετε τὰ τοξεύματα ,
traditions.KJV: Make bright the arrows ;

traditions.LXX: πληροῦτε τὰς φαρέτρας ·
traditions.KJV: gather the shields :

11.english_reference: the LORD hath raised up the spirit of the kings of the Medes

traditions.WLC: הֵעִ֣יר יְהוָ֗ה אֶת ר֨וּחַ֙ מַלְכֵ֣י מָדַ֔י
traditions.LXX: ἤγειρεν Κύριος τὸ πνεῦμα βασιλέως Μήδων ,
traditions.KJV: the LORD hath raised up the spirit of the kings of the Medes :

11.english_reference: for his device [ is ] against Babylon , to destroy it

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי עַל בָּבֶ֥ל מְזִמָּת֖ וֹ לְ הַשְׁחִיתָ֑ הּ
traditions.LXX: ὅτι εἰς Βαβυλῶνα ἡ ὀργὴ αὐτοῦ τοῦ ἐξολεθρεῦσαι αὐτήν ,
traditions.VUL: et contra Babylónem mens eius est ut perdat eam ,
traditions.KJV: for his device [ is ] against Babylon , to destroy it ;

11.english_reference: because it [ is ] the vengeance of the LORD , the vengeance of his temple

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי נִקְמַ֤ת יְהוָה֙ הִ֔יא נִקְמַ֖ת הֵיכָלֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἐκδίκησις Κυρίου ἐστίν , ἐκδίκησις λαοῦ αὐτοῦ ἐστιν .
traditions.VUL: quóniam últio Dómini est , últio templi sui .
traditions.KJV: because it [ is ] the vengeance of the LORD , the vengeance of his temple .

12.english_reference: Set up the standard upon the walls of Babylon

traditions.LXX: ἐπὶ τειχέων Βαβυλῶνος ἄρατε σημεῖον ,
traditions.KJV: Set up the standard upon the walls of Babylon ,

traditions.LXX: ἐπιστήσατε φαρέτρας ,
traditions.KJV: make the watch strong ,

traditions.LXX: ἐγείρατε φυλακάς ,
traditions.KJV: set up the watchmen ,

traditions.LXX: ἑτοιμάσατε ὅπλα ,
traditions.KJV: prepare the ambushes :

12.english_reference: for the LORD hath both devised and done that which he spake against the inhabitants of Babylon

traditions.WLC: כִּ֚י גַּם זָמַ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה גַּם עָשָׂ֕ה אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּ֖ר אֶל יֹשְׁבֵ֥י בָבֶֽל
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἐνεχείρησεν · καὶ ποιήσει Κύριος ἃ ἐλάλησεν ἐπὶ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Βαβυλῶνα ,
traditions.VUL: quia cogitávit Dóminus , et fecit quæcúmque locútus est contra habitatóres Babylónis .
traditions.KJV: for the LORD hath both devised and done that which he spake against the inhabitants of Babylon .

13.english_reference: O thou that dwellest upon many waters , abundant in treasures

traditions.WLC: שכנתי עַל מַ֣יִם רַבִּ֔ים רַבַּ֖ת אֽוֹצָרֹ֑ת
traditions.LXX: κατασκηνοῦντας ἐφ᾽ ὕδασι πολλοῖς καὶ ἐπὶ πλήθει θησαυρῶν αὐτῆς ·
traditions.VUL: Quæ hábitas super aquas multas , lócuples in thesáuris :
traditions.KJV: O thou that dwellest upon many waters , abundant in treasures ,

traditions.LXX: ἥκει τὸ πέρας σου ἀληθῶς
traditions.KJV: thine end is come , [ and ]

traditions.LXX: εἰς τὰ σπλάγχα σου .
traditions.KJV: the measure of thy covetousness .

14.english_reference: The LORD of hosts hath sworn by himself

traditions.WLC: נִשְׁבַּ֛ע יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת בְּ נַפְשׁ֑ וֹ
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ὤμοσεν Κύριος κατὰ τοῦ βραχίονος αὐτοῦ
traditions.VUL: Iurávit Dóminus exercítuum per ánimam suam :
traditions.KJV: The LORD of hosts hath sworn by himself , [ saying ] ,

14.english_reference: Surely I will fill thee with men , as with caterpillers

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י אִם מִלֵּאתִ֤י ךְ אָדָם֙ כַּ יֶּ֔לֶק
traditions.LXX: διότι Πληρώσω σε ἀνθρώπων ὡσεὶ ἀκρίδων ,
traditions.VUL: Quóniam replébo te homínibus quasi brucho ,
traditions.KJV: Surely I will fill thee with men , as with caterpillers ;

14.english_reference: and they shall lift up a shout against thee

traditions.LXX: καὶ φθέγξονται ἐπὶ σὲ οἱ καταβαίνοντες .
traditions.KJV: and they shall lift up a shout against thee .

15.english_reference: He hath made the earth by his power

traditions.LXX: Ποιῶν γῆν ἐν τῇ ἰσχύι αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: Qui fecit terram in fortitúdine sua ,
traditions.KJV: He hath made the earth by his power ,

15.english_reference: he hath established the world by his wisdom

traditions.LXX: ἑτοιμάζων οἰκουμένην ἐν τῇ σοφίᾳ αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.KJV: he hath established the world by his wisdom ,

15.english_reference: and hath stretched out the heaven by his understanding

traditions.WLC: וּ בִ תְבוּנָת֖ וֹ נָטָ֥ה שָׁמָֽיִם
traditions.LXX: ἐν τῇ συνέσει αὐτοῦ ἐξέτεινεν τὸν οὐρανόν ,
traditions.KJV: and hath stretched out the heaven by his understanding .

16.english_reference: When he uttereth [ his ] voice , [ there is ] a multitude of waters in the heavens

traditions.WLC: לְ ק֨וֹל תִּתּ֜ וֹ הֲמ֥וֹן מַ֨יִם֙ בַּ שָּׁמַ֔יִם
traditions.LXX: εἰς φωνὴν ἔθετο ἦχος ὕδατος ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ ,
traditions.VUL: Dante eo vocem , multiplicántur aquæ in cælo :
traditions.KJV: When he uttereth [ his ] voice , [ there is ] a multitude of waters in the heavens ;

16.english_reference: and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֥עַל נְשִׂאִ֖ים מִ קְצֵה אָ֑רֶץ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνήγαγεν νεφέλας ἀπ᾽ ἐσχάτου τῆς γῆς ,
traditions.VUL: qui levat nubes ab extrémo terræ ,
traditions.KJV: and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth :

traditions.LXX: ἀστραπὰς εἰς ὑετὸν ἐποίησεν
traditions.KJV: he maketh lightnings with rain ,

16.english_reference: and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֥צֵא ר֖וּחַ מֵ אֹצְרֹתָֽי ו
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξήγαγεν φῶς ἐκ τῶν θησαυρῶν αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: et prodúxit ventum de thesáuris suis .
traditions.KJV: and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures .

17.english_reference: Every man is brutish by [ his ] knowledge

traditions.LXX: ἐματαιώθη πᾶς ἄνθρωπος ἀπὸ γνώσεως ,
traditions.VUL: Stultus factus est omnis homo a sciéntia :
traditions.KJV: Every man is brutish by [ his ] knowledge ;

17.english_reference: every founder is confounded by the graven image

traditions.LXX: κατῃσχύνθη πᾶς χρυσοχόος ἀπὸ τῶν γλυπτῶν αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: confúsus est omnis conflátor in scúlptili :
traditions.KJV: every founder is confounded by the graven image :

17.english_reference: for his molten image [ is ] falsehood

traditions.LXX: ὅτι ψευδῆ ἐχώνευσαν ,
traditions.KJV: for his molten image [ is ] falsehood ,

17.english_reference: and [ there is ] no breath in them

traditions.LXX: οὐκ ἔστιν πνεῦμα ἐν αὐτοῖς .
traditions.KJV: and [ there is ] no breath in them .

18.english_reference: They [ are ] vanity , the work of errors

traditions.LXX: μάταιά ἐστιν , ἔργα μεμωκημένα ,
traditions.VUL: Vana sunt ópera , et risu digna :
traditions.KJV: They [ are ] vanity , the work of errors :

18.english_reference: in the time of their visitation they shall perish

traditions.LXX: ἐν καιρῷ ἐπισκέψεως αὐτῶν ἀπολοῦνται .
traditions.KJV: in the time of their visitation they shall perish .

19.english_reference: The portion of Jacob [ is ] not like them

traditions.LXX: οὐ τοιαύτη μερὶς τῷ Ἰακώβ ,
traditions.KJV: The portion of Jacob [ is ] not like them ;

19.english_reference: for he [ is ] the former of all things

traditions.LXX: ὅτι ὁ πλάσας τὰ πάντα αὐτός ἐστιν
traditions.VUL: quia qui fecit ómnia , ipse est ,
traditions.KJV: for he [ is ] the former of all things :

19.english_reference: and [ Israel is ] the rod of his inheritance

traditions.LXX: κληρονομία αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.KJV: and [ Israel is ] the rod of his inheritance :

19.english_reference: the LORD of hosts [ is ] his name

traditions.LXX: Κύριος ὄνομα αὐτῷ .
traditions.KJV: the LORD of hosts [ is ] his name .

20.english_reference: Thou [ art ] my battle axe [ and ] weapons of war

traditions.WLC: מַפֵּץ אַתָּ֣ה לִ֔ י כְּלֵ֖י מִלְחָמָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: διασκορπίζεις σύ μοι σκεύη πολέμου ,
traditions.KJV: Thou [ art ] my battle axe [ and ] weapons of war :

20.english_reference: for with thee will I break in pieces the nations

traditions.LXX: καὶ διασκορπιῶ ἐν σοὶ ἔθνη
traditions.VUL: et ego collídam in te gentes ,
traditions.KJV: for with thee will I break in pieces the nations ,

20.english_reference: and with thee will I destroy kingdoms

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξαρῶ ἐκ σοῦ βασιλεῖς .
traditions.KJV: and with thee will I destroy kingdoms ;

21.english_reference: And with thee will I break in pieces the horse and his rider

traditions.WLC: וְ נִפַּצְתִּ֣י בְ ךָ֔ ס֖וּס וְ רֹֽכְב֑ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ διασκορπιῶ ἐν σοὶ ἵππον καὶ ἐπιβάτην αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: et collídam in te equum , et équitem eius :

traditions.WLC: וּ מַלְּט֖וּ אִ֣ישׁ אֶת נַפְשׁ֑ וֹ מֵ חֲר֖וֹן אַף יְהוָֽה
traditions.VUL: ut salvet unusquísque ánimam suam ab ira furóris Dómini .
traditions.KJV: and deliver ye every man his soul from the fierce anger of the LORD .

46.english_reference: And lest your heart faint , and ye fear for the rumour that shall be heard in the land ;

traditions.WLC: וּ פֶן יֵרַ֤ךְ לְבַבְ כֶם֙ וְ תִֽירְא֔וּ בַּ שְּׁמוּעָ֖ה הַ נִּשְׁמַ֣עַת בָּ אָ֑רֶץ
traditions.VUL: Et ne forte molléscat cor vestrum , et timeátis audítum , qui audiétur in terra :
traditions.KJV: And lest your heart faint , and ye fear for the rumour that shall be heard in the land ;

46.english_reference: a rumour shall both come [ one ] year , and after that in [ another ] year [ shall come ] a rumour ,

traditions.WLC: וּ בָ֧א בַ שָּׁנָ֣ה הַ שְּׁמוּעָ֗ה וְ אַחֲרָ֤י ו בַּ שָּׁנָה֙ הַ שְּׁמוּעָ֔ה
traditions.VUL: et véniet in anno audítio , et post hunc annum audítio :
traditions.KJV: a rumour shall both come [ one ] year , and after that in [ another ] year [ shall come ] a rumour ,
and violence in the land ,
ruler against ruler .

47.english_reference: Therefore , behold , the days come , that I will do judgment upon the graven images of Babylon :

traditions.WLC: לָ כֵן֙ הִנֵּ֣ה יָמִ֣ים בָּאִ֔ים וּ פָקַדְתִּי֙ עַל פְּסִילֵ֣י בָבֶ֔ל
traditions.VUL: Proptérea ecce dies véniunt , et visitábo super sculptília Babylónis :
traditions.KJV: Therefore , behold , the days come , that I will do judgment upon the graven images of Babylon :

47.english_reference: and her whole land shall be confounded ,

traditions.KJV: and her whole land shall be confounded ,

47.english_reference: and all her slain shall fall in the midst of her .

traditions.WLC: וְ כָל חֲלָלֶ֖י הָ יִפְּל֥וּ בְ תוֹכָֽ הּ
traditions.VUL: et univérsi interfécti eius cadent in médio eius .
traditions.KJV: and all her slain shall fall in the midst of her .

48.english_reference: Then the heaven and the earth , and all that [ is ] therein , shall sing for Babylon :

traditions.WLC: וְ רִנְּנ֤וּ עַל בָּבֶל֙ שָׁמַ֣יִם וָ אָ֔רֶץ וְ כֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּ הֶ֑ם
traditions.VUL: Et laudábunt super Babylónem cæli et terra , et ómnia quæ in eis sunt :
traditions.KJV: Then the heaven and the earth , and all that [ is ] therein , shall sing for Babylon :

48.english_reference: for the spoilers shall come unto her from the north , saith the LORD .

traditions.WLC: כִּ֧י מִ צָּפ֛וֹן יָבוֹא לָ֥ הּ הַ שּׁוֹדְדִ֖ים נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
traditions.VUL: quia ab aquilóne vénient ei prædónes , ait Dóminus .
traditions.KJV: for the spoilers shall come unto her from the north , saith the LORD .

49.english_reference: As Babylon [ hath caused ] the slain of Israel to fall ,

traditions.WLC: גַּם בָּבֶ֕ל לִ נְפֹּ֖ל חַֽלְלֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל
traditions.VUL: Et quómodo fecit Bábylon , ut cáderent occísi in Israel :
traditions.KJV: As Babylon [ hath caused ] the slain of Israel to fall ,

49.english_reference: so at Babylon shall fall the slain of all the earth .

traditions.WLC: גַּם לְ בָבֶ֥ל נָפְל֖וּ חַֽלְלֵ֥י כָל הָ אָֽרֶץ
traditions.VUL: sic de Babylóne cadent occísi in univérsa terra .
traditions.KJV: so at Babylon shall fall the slain of all the earth .

50.english_reference: Ye that have escaped the sword , go away , stand not still :

traditions.WLC: פְּלֵטִ֣ים מֵ חֶ֔רֶב הִלְכ֖וּ אַֽל תַּעֲמֹ֑דוּ
traditions.VUL: Qui fugístis gládium , veníte , nolíte stare :
traditions.KJV: Ye that have escaped the sword , go away , stand not still :
remember the LORD afar off ,

50.english_reference: and let Jerusalem come into your mind .

traditions.WLC: וִ ירֽוּשָׁלִַ֖ם תַּעֲלֶ֥ה עַל לְבַבְ כֶֽם
traditions.VUL: et Ierúsalem ascéndat super cor vestrum
traditions.KJV: and let Jerusalem come into your mind .

51.english_reference: We are confounded , because we have heard reproach

traditions.KJV: We are confounded , because we have heard reproach :
shame hath covered our faces :

51.english_reference: for strangers are come into the sanctuaries of the LORD ’S house

traditions.WLC: כִּ֚י בָּ֣אוּ זָרִ֔ים עַֽל מִקְדְּשֵׁ֖י בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה
traditions.VUL: quia venérunt aliéni super sanctificatiónem domus Dómini .
traditions.KJV: for strangers are come into the sanctuaries of the LORD ’S house .

52.english_reference: Wherefore , behold , the days come , saith the LORD

traditions.WLC: לָ כֵ֞ן הִנֵּֽה יָמִ֤ים בָּאִים֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה
traditions.VUL: Proptérea ecce dies véniunt , ait Dóminus :
traditions.KJV: Wherefore , behold , the days come , saith the LORD ,

52.english_reference: that I will do judgment upon her graven images

traditions.KJV: that I will do judgment upon her graven images :

52.english_reference: and through all her land the wounded shall groan

traditions.WLC: וּ בְ כָל אַרְצָ֖ הּ יֶאֱנֹ֥ק חָלָֽל
traditions.VUL: et in omni terra eius múgiet vulnerátus .
traditions.KJV: and through all her land the wounded shall groan .

53.english_reference: Though Babylon should mount up to heaven

traditions.KJV: Though Babylon should mount up to heaven ,

53.english_reference: and though she should fortify the height of her strength

traditions.WLC: וְ כִ֥י תְבַצֵּ֖ר מְר֣וֹם עֻזָּ֑ הּ
traditions.VUL: et firmáverit in excélso robur suum :
traditions.KJV: and though she should fortify the height of her strength , [ yet ]

53.english_reference: [ yet ] from me shall spoilers come unto her , saith the LORD

traditions.WLC: מֵ אִתִּ֗ י יָבֹ֧אוּ שֹׁדְדִ֛ים לָ֖ הּ נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
traditions.VUL: a me vénient vastatóres eius , ait Dóminus .
traditions.KJV: from me shall spoilers come unto her , saith the LORD .

54.english_reference: A sound of a cry [ cometh ] from Babylon

traditions.KJV: A sound of a cry [ cometh ] from Babylon ,

54.english_reference: and great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans

traditions.WLC: וְ שֶׁ֥בֶר גָּד֖וֹל מֵ אֶ֥רֶץ כַּשְׂדִּֽים
traditions.VUL: et contrítio magna de terra Chaldæórum :
traditions.KJV: and great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans :

55.english_reference: Because the LORD hath spoiled Babylon , and destroyed out of her the great voice

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי שֹׁדֵ֤ד יְהוָה֙ אֶת בָּבֶ֔ל וְ אִבַּ֥ד מִמֶּ֖ נָּה ק֣וֹל גָּד֑וֹל
traditions.VUL: quóniam vastávit Dóminus Babylónem , et pérdidit ex ea vocem magnam :
traditions.KJV: Because the LORD hath spoiled Babylon , and destroyed out of her the great voice ;

55.english_reference: when her waves do roar like great waters

traditions.WLC: וְ הָמ֤וּ גַלֵּי הֶם֙ כְּ מַ֣יִם רַבִּ֔ים
traditions.VUL: et sonábunt fluctus eórum quasi aquæ multæ :
traditions.KJV: when her waves do roar like great waters ,

55.english_reference: a noise of their voice is uttered

traditions.KJV: a noise of their voice is uttered :

56.english_reference: Because the spoiler is come upon her , [ even ] upon Babylon

traditions.WLC: כִּי֩ בָ֨א עָלֶ֤י הָ עַל בָּבֶל֙ שׁוֹדֵ֔ד
traditions.VUL: quia venit super eam , id est super Babylónem prædo ,
traditions.KJV: Because the spoiler is come upon her , [ even ] upon Babylon ,

56.english_reference: and her mighty men are taken , every one of their bows is broken

traditions.WLC: וְ נִלְכְּדוּ֙ גִּבּוֹרֶ֔י הָ חִתְּתָ֖ה קַשְּׁתוֹתָ֑ ם
traditions.VUL: et apprehénsi sunt fortes eius , et emárcuit arcus eórum :
traditions.KJV: and her mighty men are taken , every one of their bows is broken :

56.english_reference: for the LORD God of recompences shall surely requite

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י אֵ֧ל גְּמֻל֛וֹת יְהוָ֖ה שַׁלֵּ֥ם יְשַׁלֵּֽם
traditions.VUL: quia fortis ultor Dóminus reddens retríbuet .
traditions.KJV: for the LORD God of recompences shall surely requite .

57.english_reference: And I will make drunk her princes , and her wise [ men ] , her captains , and her rulers , and her mighty men

traditions.WLC: וְ֠ הִשְׁכַּרְתִּי שָׂרֶ֨י הָ וַ חֲכָמֶ֜י הָ פַּחוֹתֶ֤י הָ וּ סְגָנֶ֨י הָ֙ וְ גִבּוֹרֶ֔י הָ
traditions.VUL: Et inebriábo príncipes eius , et sapiéntes eius , et duces eius , et magistrátus eius ,
traditions.KJV: And I will make drunk her princes , and her wise [ men ] , her captains , and her rulers , and her mighty men :

57.english_reference: and they shall sleep a perpetual sleep , and not wake

traditions.WLC: וְ יָשְׁנ֥וּ שְׁנַת עוֹלָ֖ם וְ לֹ֣א יָקִ֑יצוּ
traditions.VUL: et fortes eius : et dórmient somnum sempitérnum , et non expergiscéntur ,
traditions.KJV: and they shall sleep a perpetual sleep , and not wake ,

57.english_reference: saith the King , whose name [ is ] the LORD of hosts

traditions.WLC: נְאֻ֨ם הַ מֶּ֔לֶךְ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽ וֹ
traditions.VUL: ait rex , Dóminus exercítuum nomen eius .
traditions.KJV: saith the King , whose name [ is ] the LORD of hosts .

58.english_reference: Thus saith the LORD of hosts

traditions.KJV: Thus saith the LORD of hosts ;

58.english_reference: The broad walls of Babylon shall be utterly broken

traditions.WLC: חֹ֠מוֹת בָּבֶ֤ל הָֽ רְחָבָה֙ עַרְעֵ֣ר תִּתְעַרְעָ֔ר
traditions.VUL: Murus Babylónis ille latíssimus suffossióne suffodiétur ,
traditions.KJV: The broad walls of Babylon shall be utterly broken ,

58.english_reference: and her high gates shall be burned with fire

traditions.WLC: וּ שְׁעָרֶ֥י הָ הַ גְּבֹהִ֖ים בָּ אֵ֣שׁ יִצַּ֑תּוּ
traditions.VUL: et portæ eius excélsæ igni comburéntur ,
traditions.KJV: and her high gates shall be burned with fire ;

58.english_reference: and the people shall labour in vain , and the folk in the fire , and they shall be weary

traditions.WLC: וְ יִֽגְע֨וּ עַמִּ֧ים בְּ דֵי רִ֛יק וּ לְאֻמִּ֥ים בְּ דֵי אֵ֖שׁ וְ יָעֵֽפוּ
traditions.VUL: et labóres populórum ad níhilum , et géntium in ignem erunt , et disperíbunt .
traditions.KJV: and the people shall labour in vain , and the folk in the fire , and they shall be weary .

59.english_reference: The word which Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Neriah , the son of Maaseiah

traditions.WLC: הַ דָּבָ֞ר אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֣ה יִרְמְיָ֣הוּ הַ נָּבִ֗יא אֶת שְׂרָיָ֣ה בֶן נֵרִיָּה֮ בֶּן מַחְסֵיָה֒
traditions.VUL: Verbum , quod præcépit Ieremías prophéta Saraíæ fílio Neríæ fílii Maasíæ ,
traditions.KJV: The word which Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Neriah , the son of Maaseiah ,

59.english_reference: when he went with Zedekiah the king of Judah into Babylon in the fourth year of his reign

traditions.WLC: בְּ לֶכְתּ֞ וֹ אֶת צִדְקִיָּ֤הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָה֙ בָּבֶ֔ל בִּ שְׁנַ֥ת הָ רְבִעִ֖ית לְ מָלְכ֑ וֹ
traditions.VUL: cum pérgeret cum Sedecía rege in Babylónem , in anno quarto regni eius :
traditions.KJV: when he went with Zedekiah the king of Judah into Babylon in the fourth year of his reign .

59.english_reference: And [ this ] Seraiah [ was ] a quiet prince

traditions.KJV: And [ this ] Seraiah [ was ] a quiet prince .

60.english_reference: So Jeremiah wrote in a book all the evil that should come upon Babylon

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּכְתֹּ֣ב יִרְמְיָ֗הוּ אֵ֧ת כָּל הָ רָעָ֛ה אֲשֶׁר תָּב֥וֹא אֶל בָּבֶ֖ל אֶל סֵ֣פֶר אֶחָ֑ד
traditions.VUL: Et scripsit Ieremías omne malum , quod ventúrum erat super Babylónem , in libro uno :
traditions.KJV: So Jeremiah wrote in a book all the evil that should come upon Babylon , [ even ]

60.english_reference: [ even ] all these words that are written against Babylon

traditions.WLC: אֵ֚ת כָּל הַ דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ אֵ֔לֶּה הַ כְּתֻבִ֖ים אֶל בָּבֶֽל
traditions.VUL: ómnia verba hæc quæ scripta sunt contra Babylónem .
traditions.KJV: all these words that are written against Babylon .
And Jeremiah said to Seraiah ,
When thou comest to Babylon ,
and shalt see ,

61.english_reference: and shalt read all these words

traditions.WLC: וְֽ קָרָ֔אתָ אֵ֥ת כָּל הַ דְּבָרִ֖ים הָ אֵֽלֶּה
traditions.KJV: and shalt read all these words ;

62.english_reference: Then shalt thou say, O LORD, thou hast spoken against this place, to cut it off

traditions.WLC: וְ אָמַרְתָּ֗ יְהוָה֙ אַתָּ֨ה דִבַּ֜רְתָּ אֶל הַ מָּק֤וֹם הַ זֶּה֙ לְ הַכְרִית֔ וֹ
traditions.VUL: dices : Dómine tu locútus es contra locum istum , ut dispérderes eum :
traditions.KJV: Then shalt thou say , O LORD , thou hast spoken against this place , to cut it off ,

62.english_reference: that none shall remain in it, neither man nor beast

traditions.WLC: לְ בִלְתִּ֤י הֱיֽוֹת בּ וֹ֙ יוֹשֵׁ֔ב לְ מֵ אָדָ֖ם וְ עַד בְּהֵמָ֑ה
traditions.VUL: ne sit qui in eo hábitet ab hómine usque ad pecus ,
traditions.KJV: that none shall remain in it , neither man nor beast ,

62.english_reference: but that it shall be desolate for ever

traditions.KJV: but that it shall be desolate for ever .

63.english_reference: And it shall be, when thou hast made an end of reading this book

traditions.WLC: וְ הָיָה֙ כְּ כַלֹּ֣תְ ךָ֔ לִ קְרֹ֖א אֶת הַ סֵּ֣פֶר הַ זֶּ֑ה
traditions.KJV: And it shall be , when thou hast made an end of reading this book , [ that ]

63.english_reference: thou shalt bind a stone to it

traditions.KJV: thou shalt bind a stone to it ,

63.english_reference: and cast it into the midst of Euphrates

traditions.WLC: וְ הִשְׁלַכְתּ֖ וֹ אֶל תּ֥וֹךְ פְּרָֽת
traditions.VUL: et proícies illum in médium Euphráten :
traditions.KJV: and cast it into the midst of Euphrates :

traditions.KJV: And thou shalt say , Thus shall Babylon sink ,

64.english_reference: and shall not rise from the evil that I will bring upon her

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹֽא תָקוּם֙ מִ פְּנֵ֣י הָ רָעָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י מֵבִ֥יא עָלֶ֖י הָ
traditions.VUL: et non consúrget a fácie afflictiónis , quam ego addúco super eam ,
traditions.KJV: and shall not rise from the evil that I will bring upon her :
and they shall be weary .

64.english_reference: Thus far are the words of Jeremiah

traditions.KJV: Thus far [ are ] the words of Jeremiah .
